ops-oncall: set alerts: p99>3s for 5m, gpu_oom any, token_error_rate>0.5%. incident channel ready if needed.
alan: please publish rollback snippet here for ops quick-run.

```
deploy-bot rollback --env=release-qa --kernel=quant-v3.9 --note="auto-rollback"
```
deploy-bot: Preflight: staging smoke ok. p50 +0.01s p99 +0.08s. bundle=sha256:9f8b7c... artifacts=/artifacts/7223334445/preflight-diff.txt
nora: starting 10% now. monitor link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/7223334445
deploy-bot: Stage=10% complete. no alerts in 8m. progressing to 60%.

sasha: adding release-note blurb: "quant-kernel v4.0: packing path optimization, monitor long-sequence p99."
ops-oncall: pinned bundle in cfg to sha256:9f8b7c... handoff to release. if anything pops, reopen thread.
nora: thanks everyone. closing thread. :rocket:
thread_summary: Staged swap of quant-kernel v4.0 into release-qa: preflight checks, pinned bundle hash, rollback command, staged rollout updates, post-deploy artifacts, and release-note handoff.
